Lower bound6.4, its hard instance lemmas and external lower-bound citations are context for minimax optimality, not prerequisites of this upper bound. Heterogeneous, convex, synchronized-start and asynchronous-SGD comparisons are distinct results and excluded. Appendix I claims protocol equivalence but its displayed recurrence omits stale-tag filtering and starts workers inconsistently; it is not used as a true premise. We instead prove operational correspondence directly from Methods4/5, retaining the startup/restart cost accounting. The clocks, sample reindexing, integer prefix selection and zero-noise convention are explicit review obligations. Measurability is a stated ordinary stochastic-oracle interpretation. No Lean has been generated. Revised classification distinguishes source convergence from its dependency role: D.8,7.4 and7.5 each require a public export. Mathematical batch-prefix adapters and separate no-delay iteration contexts make their public realization explicit. The two additional transport nodes implement required public representations; they do not add source theorems or retarget the user request.
